summary: On OpenShift, expose a webhook rulebook (e.g. ansible.eda.webhook on 0.0.0.0:5000 calling run_job_template) by creating a Route to the activation service (e.g. activation-job-1-5000, targetPort 5000, edge TLS), then test with curl -X POST to the route host with Content-Type application/json; no port needed.
questions: How do I expose an EDA webhook activation on OpenShift?
Example OpenShift Route for a rulebook activation webhook
How do I test an ansible.eda.webhook source with curl?
Which service name does an activation webhook get?

answer_card.title: Expose a webhook activation on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
kind: Route
apiVersion: route.openshift.io/v1
metadata:
  name: my-webhook
  namespace: <namespace>
spec:
  host: <route-host>
  to:
    kind: Service
    name: activation-job-1-5000   # activation service
    weight: 100
  port:
    targetPort: 5000
  tls:
    termination: edge
    insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy: Redirect
```
Test (no port needed, the Route sets it):
```bash
curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST <route-host> -d '{}'
```
